content.short: Felix is a borrowing and savings protocol on Hyperliquid built around its own stablecoin.
content.description: Felix is a synthetic dollar protocol on Hyperliquid L1 that lets users borrow against collateral and hold the proceeds as a stablecoin. Its USDhl token is built for the Hyperliquid ecosystem as a base layer for HIP-3 markets, FX and payments. Felix Vaults lend deposited assets through Morpho vaults so idle balances still earn interest. A native stablecoin issued against local collateral reduces a chain's dependence on bridged dollars.
